principles: one canonical evidence path per gate
documentation does not authorize production deployment or external outreach
umbrella and focused branches must not be merged blindly
legal tax privacy and source-rights conclusions require their own qualified sign-off where applicable

items.topic: Historical Investor Ready umbrella and superseded combined branches
closeCriteria: use focused current-main survivors for final merge/evidence decisions
harvest remaining unique evidence by subject gate
never use historical umbrella or combined branches as blind wholesale merge sources

g1ReadyRule.rule: G1 may be declared ACQUISITION_CLEAN only when every non-reference item is DONE, all exact-head evidence is archived, known exceptions/carve-outs are explicit, and no required legal/privacy/tax/source-rights sign-off remains pending.

mergeHygiene: rebase or rebuild focused candidate on current main before final merge if branch divergence is material
do not merge overlapping umbrella and focused PRs without diff reconciliation
record which PR supersedes which earlier candidate
rerun evidence after dependency or runtime changes
buyer data-room status must reference the actually merged/acquired state, not a historical green branch
